title: Hinomori Shiho — Bonds And Grief〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, that should be good for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay. But sorry about this, everyone.
I appreciate you all sticking around for this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! I wanted to work on my part some more as well, so it wasn't all just you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, same here! And I also like seeing how gung-ho you've been for band stuff lately, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? I guess I wanted to put Nene's singing tips into practice more than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to her, I feel like I'm getting closer to singing the way I've been imagining that I could.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Totally! I mean today...
You were GLORIOUS! Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho! We were just talking about MORE MORE JUMP!'s stream from yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait... Did you watch it too, Shiho?!
Please tell me what you thought! Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure! Where to start...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Minori looks like she's been having a lot of fun lately. Almost as much as Saki when she's really riding high.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And she's freelancing as an idol on top of that. I don't know anything about idols but that has to be hard work.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
I really appreciate your feedback!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! Do you have any suggestions or requests for our next video?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you're taking requests, I'd love to see a video where you share tips for getting better at singing, or talk about what you do for vocal training!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Kohane's changed too...
And I don't just mean her hairstyle either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She said that she and her friends are working towards the same goal now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You formed a group with some students from Kamiyama, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's right! They're amazing singers and have way more experience than me. That's why I have to work twice as hard to catch up to them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But she seems like she's enjoying it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(If you really set your mind on something,
I guess it can be fun, even if it's difficult.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's like Ichika and these two have this sparkle to them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And what am I doing with my life...? I'm at a crossroads and don't know which way to go...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I didn't use to be like that...
Before Saki returned from the hospital,
these choices came easily to me...)
—! Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Are you okay?
You look like a deflated balloon...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay. I was just thinking about...
Wait, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I, um... I've got math next... 
But I think I left my textbook at home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I beg you, Shiho!
Please let me borrow yours!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's it?
Um, here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thaaanks!
You're my savior!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, okay! And quit it with the hugs!
The bell's ringing, so get back to class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! I'll bring it straight back after I'm done!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next problem... Minori, can you solve this one?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Of course I want to go pro...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't focus on this class at all...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! Thanks for lending me your textbook!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No problem.
Make sure to bring your own next time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I will! I've gotta go to P.E. now.
See you after school, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, later.
She's always in a hurry... Hm, what's this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's something stuck between the pages.
I hope it's not a worksheet she forgot...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, wait. It's a page from her notebook.
Probably just doodles... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
To Shiho,
Going to PXL together was loads of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I drew a picture so that you can remember how great it was♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She drew a scene from Phoenix Wonderland...
Is that Tsukasa on stage?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki...
She spent the lesson doodling instead of learning...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Well, she made it for me so...
I guess I should keep it.)
